decisions: Reuse current Target Index and expanded Visual Control evidence; do not run broad rediscovery.
Use Atlasfin as priority visual reference but promote only evidence-backed recipe-level candidates; do not guess family or preset variants.
Do not inspect or fall back to the Surface Visual Governor Materiality Catalog; keep it STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.
Preserve null/UNRESOLVED values where current machine authority is ambiguous; unknown stays unknown.
Do not mint canonical NDC, VIS, BND, TGT, LYR, Identity recipe/family/preset, or adapter IDs from the surface worker.
Treat lane output as candidate exchange data only, never as Work Entry authorization, GVAE receipt, runtime certification, or canonical authority.

Remain in HOLD and wait only for an explicit evidence-backed bounded correction request from Chat 6/integration.
Create only a certified derivative under prisma-html/governance/visual-promotion/candidates/tablet/certification/**; never rewrite the original worker shard.
Use the Chat 6 strict candidate/manifest contract as the intake authority for representation normalization, preserving every semantic decision and both DRIFT conflicts.

Publish the certification head for Chat 6 consumption and make no PR or FILES_MANIFEST update from Chat 1.

For this phase, perform only independent read-only verification from exact certification head-tree bytes and write only this mailbox branch. Do not mutate certification bytes, candidate shards, product/runtime, global authority or FILES_MANIFEST.json.
